arms.name: left
arms.provenance: Converter-written (tools/ingest/sources/robocoin.py) from the vendor's eef_sim_pose_state: per arm x y z in metres and an extrinsic xyz Euler triple (R = Rz Ry Rx) in the vendor's unified base frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the base or between the feet), re-expressed as a unit xyzw quaternion with w >= 0 by tools/ingest/poses.arm_block. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.name: right

Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.name: right
arms.provenance: As the left arm, at its own offset: columns 8 to 15 of the sixteen-wide row; the sim pose names are looked up per arm, never by position (RMC's native state lists the right arm first, the sim pose does not). Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.provenance: Converter-written (tools/ingest/sources/robocoin.py) from the vendor's eef_sim_pose_state: per arm x y z in metres and an extrinsic xyz Euler triple (R = Rz Ry Rx) in the vendor's unified base frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the base or between the feet), re-expressed as a unit xyzw quaternion with w >= 0 by tools/ingest/poses.arm_block. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.name: right
arms.provenance: As the left arm, at its own offset: columns 8 to 15 of the sixteen-wide row; the sim pose names are looked up per arm, never by position (RMC's native state lists the right arm first, the sim pose does not). Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.provenance: Converter-written (tools/ingest/sources/robocoin.py) from the vendor's eef_sim_pose_state: per arm x y z in metres and an extrinsic xyz Euler triple (R = Rz Ry Rx) in the vendor's unified base frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the base or between the feet), re-expressed as a unit xyzw quaternion with w >= 0 by tools/ingest/poses.arm_block. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.provenance: Converter-written (tools/ingest/sources/robocoin.py) from the vendor's eef_sim_pose_state: per arm x y z in metres and an extrinsic xyz Euler triple (R = Rz Ry Rx) in the vendor's unified base frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the base or between the feet), re-expressed as a unit xyzw quaternion with w >= 0 by tools/ingest/poses.arm_block. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

arms.name: left
arms.provenance: Converter-written (tools/ingest/sources/robocoin.py) from the vendor's eef_sim_pose_state: per arm x y z in metres and an extrinsic xyz Euler triple (R = Rz Ry Rx) in the vendor's unified base frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the base or between the feet), re-expressed as a unit xyzw quaternion with w >= 0 by tools/ingest/poses.arm_block. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more. Dexterous hands, no aperture recorded : the end-effector pose is measured (the vendor's sim pose, as every RoboCOIN robot's) and the gripper is not recorded: its columns (7, 15 of the state, 6, 13 of the action) are NaN and the layout's gripper is null. The hand joints are observation.hand (v7).

action.provenance: Not measured: constructed. Both factors are exactly one; the frame is spatial because the rotation is composed on the left; an episode whose deltas do not integrate back onto its poses within 1e-4 cm and 1e-5 rad is refused.

action.common_base_frame_provenance: Both poses are in torso_link4 (vendor: pose_ee_arm_* is the gripper link relative to torso_link4). Measured: on steps where an arm's joints move < 2e-4 rad while the torso moves > 2e-3 rad (224,306 left, 271,610 right steps) the arm's pose moves a median 0.00014 cm, as on fully still steps, so the frame rides the torso; at zero joints the two poses sit at y = +/-0.335 m with identity rotation.
action.provenance: Not measured: constructed. The source records absolute target joint positions and no end-effector command or URDF, so each row is built from the measured poses: (p[t+1] - p[t]) * 100 cm and log(R[t+1] R[t]^T) rad in torso_link4 (spatial, rotation composed on the left), refused unless the deltas integrate back onto the poses within 1e-4 cm and 1e-5 rad (tools/ingest/poses.py). The gripper column is the commanded target action.<arm>_gripper at t (0..100, high = open), not the measured gripper at t + 1: it leads the measured gripper by about 6 rows while the measured pose lags its joint command by about 4, so within one row the gripper is about 4 rows (0.27 s) ahead of the arm on the operator's timeline. action_valid is 0 on the last row, on steps moving > 6 cm on an axis (AgiBot V8), and on schema-A rows labelled unqualified (tools/ingest/galaxea_owd/rules.py galaxea_owd_rules_v3). The v6 mask of the steps on which the base or the torso moves is lifted in v7: the base's commanded motion and the torso joints are the body block, and the arm poses ride torso_link4.

ee_frame_fix.evidence: split_aloha approaches along EE +z (the TCP offset, checked on every episode) and closes along EE x (the stated wrist mounts' image x, 2026-10-01 check; the fingers separate along image x in the wrist frames); R_c puts approach on z and closing on y, the stage-1 convention of config/embodiments.yaml. The loader check gates it against tools/audit_ee_frame_conventions.py on every run.

frequency.evidence: info.json fps 30 in every sim_updated dataset; the source timestamp column steps 1/30 s (checked per episode by the converter, 0.1 ms tolerance) and the AV1 pts step 512/15360 s. The timestamp is the simulator's recording clock k/30, not an independent measurement.

gripper.evidence: split_aloha: raw stroke [0.0, 0.1], open = high. states gripper correlates +0.83..+0.998 with master_actions openness (1 = open) on 20 of 22 sampled arms, and wrist frames at the max / min value show the fingers apart / closed on the object. A row outside the stroke by more than 0.02 of the span has its action masked; an episode with more than 0.1 of its rows outside is refused.

arms.name: single
arms.provenance: Columns from meta/info.json motor names (x_cm.. gripper), quaternion norm checked at 1.000000 by validate. The stored value is the gripper command over the detected full stroke (rh20t_gripper_scales.json, dahuan_ag95, scale 95.0), so 1.0 is the full stroke. Every episode starts at 1.0 and ends at 0.0, which is open then grasped. Confirm against the converter before pretraining.

action.common_base_frame_provenance: The vendor states both arms' eef_sim_pose_state in one unified base frame (STATE provenance above), and the survey's sign check puts the left arm at larger y than the right in every episode of every non-quarantined variant.
action.provenance: Not measured: constructed, as RoboTwin's. tools/ingest/poses.arm_block builds each row from the recorded sim poses, the translation as (p[t+1] - p[t]) * 100 in centimetres and the rotation as log(R[t+1] R[t]^T) in radians, so both factors are exactly one; the frame is spatial because the rotation composes on the left, which is what neo_vla.eval.pose.apply_delta reads back. Every episode is refused unless its deltas integrate back onto its own poses within 1e-4 cm and 1e-5 rad. The gripper column holds the next row's gripper_open_scale_state (1 open); the last row states no step (action_valid 0). The source's joint-space action column is never read.

frequency.evidence: meta/info.json fps of the source directory, copied unchanged: every declared video's average rate equals it (351,173/351,173). The stored timestamps are frame_index / fps (per-episode spread <= 1.53e-5 s over 102,971 episodes), synthetic rather than a clock, so no stored clock is written and none can confirm the rate; the vendor's deploy scripts mention --frequency=10 [unverified what that controls].

gripper.evidence: gripper_open_scale_state in [0, 1]: Pearson r against the vendor's per-frame gripper_mode (0 open, 1 closed, 2 unknown excluded) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes with variance (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98), so 1 is open (, fullscan.py); the vendor README says the same. Observed extent 0.0-1.0 (AgiBot-g1 0.17-0.98, Galbot 0.08-0.92); the stroke is declared [0, 1] so one physical stroke maps to one canonical range in every directory. The converter re-checks the sign per episode.

arms.name: left
arms.provenance: Converter-written (tools/ingest/sources/robocoin.py) from the vendor's eef_sim_pose_state: per arm x y z in metres and an extrinsic xyz Euler triple (R = Rz Ry Rx) in the vendor's unified base frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the base or between the feet), re-expressed as a unit xyzw quaternion with w >= 0 by tools/ingest/poses.arm_block. The Euler order was measured, not assumed: against AgiBot-g1's SDK quaternion only the xyz reading gives a constant end-effector offset (median spread 0.09-0.63 deg over 9 moving arm-episodes, runner-up >= 10.8 deg) and against the Cobot/Agilex SDK Euler it holds to 0.003-0.6 deg; metres by the SDK displacement ratio 0.998-1.002 (, rotconv3.py). Galbot, R1 Lite and RealMan record no SDK orientation to compare against (RealMan's SDK Euler sits in another base, spread 0.3-7.2 deg): the same vendor pipeline is assumed there [unverified per robot]. The gripper column is gripper_open_scale_state, 1 open and 0 closed: its correlation with the vendor's gripper_mode label (1 closed) is negative in 112,248 of 112,248 arm-episodes (per-variant median -0.71 to -0.98, ), and the converter refuses any episode where it is +0.5 or more.

arms.name: right
arms.provenance: As the left arm, at its own offset: columns 8 to 15 of the sixteen-wide row; the sim pose names are looked up per arm, never by position (RMC's native state lists the right arm first, the sim pose does not).
